title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — 'Adam sinned for us' leads to denying our original sin
pass_a_gloss: Therefore Garrigues's assertion that Adam sinned for us drives straight toward denying that we have original sin of our own at all—that is where Placeus says the claim leads.
pass_b_english: You see where that assertion of yours—that Adam sinned for us—leads you: namely to denying our original sin.
source_text: Vides quo te ducat tua ista assertio pro nobis peccasse Adamum: nimirum ad negandum peccatum nostrum originale.

choices.choice: Leads to denying our original sin

notes: Cap. IX missa/poena densify section 645 from locked 1661 Latin (pp. 354–355 tip).
